description: Links defense and attack, supporting both offensive and defensive phases.
Operates on the flank of the midfield, linking play and using diagonal passes to escape pressure.
Receives passes from deep positions and advances into the attacking midfield line, roaming to create passing options as a creative threat.
Finds space between the lines to create chances and act as a goal threat.
Finds gaps between the lines to receive the ball, roaming to create passing options and deliver decisive passes in the final third.
Breaks into channels and underlaps to link with wide attackers and provide dangerous crosses.
